channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Smarter personalization: How property data helps us understand user price sensitivity
item.description: Introduction Existing systems estimate user price sensitivity primarily from spending behavior or demographic proxies. They do not systematically account for residential property values, which can indicate a user’s financial circumstances. (1 source: grab)

item.title: Perseus: A Fail-Slow Detection Framework for Cloud Storage Systems (2023)
item.description: Abstract: The newly-emerging “fail-slow” failures plague both software and hardware where the victim components are still functioning yet with degraded performance. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
item.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings. (2 sources: cloudflare, hackernews)

item.title: QCon London 2027 Announces 15 Tracks on Production AI, Architecture, and Engineering at Scale
item.description: A preview of the 15-track QCon London 2027 program, covering agent evaluation and guardrails, AI-era architecture, distributed-system debugging, modern data platforms, high-performance engineering, and Staff+ leadership. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Everything we launched during Birthday Week 2026
item.description: We celebrated our 16th birthday with 46 announcements across open source, post-quantum security, AI agents, and developer platform upgrades. Here’s a day-by-day roundup of everything we shipped. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns
item.description: A year after announcing our goal to hire 1,111 interns, more than 750 early-career builders have shipped real products across 48 teams at Cloudflare. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
item.description: We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics. (1 source: githubblog)
